about: Poplar Grove Historic House and Museum hosts Merry and Bright, A Holiday of Lights, in Wilmington.
It is the museum's most popular fundraiser of the year.
The first three weekends are Friday through Sunday from 5 to 9 PM.
The last stretch runs Friday through Tuesday and ends December 22.
Admission includes the lighted grounds and lit trees.
Santa hears wishes at the Gazebo starting at 5 PM.
The last call to join Santa's line is 8:30 PM.
Kids can visit Grinch's Junk Shop, Bumble's Snowball Party and Santa's Boot Camp.
Campfires for marshmallows and outdoor holiday movies are on site.
A balloon artist sculpts creations for the kids.
Well-behaved leashed pets are welcome on Sunday nights only.
faq: When is Merry and Bright at Poplar Grove?
Select nights from November 27 to December 22, 2026, from 5 to 9 PM.
Poplar Grove Historic House and Museum, 10200 US Hwy 17 N, Wilmington, NC 28411.
$10 for all ages, with children 2 and under free, and $35 for a family pass.
Who is covered by the family pass?
Two adults and two children ages 2 to 11.
